author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
@benwerd Call it ageism if you wan't but I also do not want to bank on someone making it to 80 to fill out a term. Though I think Buttigieg will end up as Governor for Indiana (probably a harder election than US Pres). Beto..seems to memeish..but I backed Edwards over Obama...what do I now.

At the electoral college level Biden does make sense. Wins PA without much effort
